selected_evidence.requirement: Default umask 027 for new interactive login sessions
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the persistent configuration and successful pre- and post-restart login tests for both regular and root users.
Captures the healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, restored system/SSH health, unchanged configuration hash, and recovered umask behavior.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'os='; cat /etc/redhat-release
printf 'uid='; id -u
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running 2>&1 || true
printf 'sshd_active='; systemctl is-active sshd 2>&1 || true
printf 'sshd_enabled='; systemctl is-enabled sshd 2>&1 || true
printf 'ssh_listener='; ss -lntp 2>/dev/null | awk '$4 ~ /:22$/ {print $4, $6}'
printf 'root_login_umask='; /bin/bash --login -c 'umask'
printf 'root_interactive_login_umask='; /bin/bash --login -i -c 'umask' 2>/dev/null
printf '%s\n' '--- active umask directives ---'
for f in /etc/profile /etc/bashrc /etc/login.defs /etc/profile.d/*.sh; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  if grep -nE '(^|[[:space:]])(umask|UMASK)([[:space:]]|$)' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    printf '[%s]\n' "$f"
    grep -nE '(^|[[:space:]])(umask|UMASK)([[:space:]]|$)' "$f" || true
  fi
done

--- /etc/profile lines 45-90 ---
HOSTNAME=`/usr/bin/hostname 2>/dev/null`
HISTSIZE=1000
if [ "$HISTCONTROL" = "ignorespace" ] ; then
    export HISTCONTROL=ignoreboth
else
    export HISTCONTROL=ignoredups
fi

export PATH USER LOGNAME MAIL HOSTNAME HISTSIZE HISTCONTROL

# By default, we want umask to get set. This sets it for login shell
# Current threshold for system reserved uid/gids is 200
# You could check uidgid reservation validity in
# /usr/share/doc/setup-*/uidgid file
if [ $UID -gt 199 ] && [ "`/usr/bin/id -gn`" = "`/usr/bin/id -un`" ]; then
    umask 002
else
    umask 022
fi

for i in /etc/profile.d/*.sh /etc/profile.d/sh.local ; do
    if [ -r "$i" ]; then
        if [ "${-#*i}" != "$-" ]; then 
            . "$i"
        else
            . "$i" >/dev/null
        fi
    fi
done

unset i
unset -f pathmunge
--- /etc/bashrc lines 55-95 ---
            *:"$1":*)
                ;;
            *)
                if [ "$2" = "after" ] ; then
                    PATH=$PATH:$1
                else
                    PATH=$1:$PATH
                fi
        esac
    }

    # By default, we want umask to get set. This sets it for non-login shell.
    # Current threshold for system reserved uid/gids is 200
    # You could check uidgid reservation validity in
    # /usr/share/doc/setup-*/uidgid file
    if [ $UID -gt 199 ] && [ "`/usr/bin/id -gn`" = "`/usr/bin/id -un`" ]; then
       umask 002
    else
       umask 022
    fi

    SHELL=/bin/bash
    # Only display echos from profile.d scripts if we are no login shell
    # and interactive - otherwise just process them to set envvars
    for i in /etc/profile.d/*.sh; do
        if [ -r "$i" ]; then
            if [ "$PS1" ]; then
                . "$i"
            else
                . "$i" >/dev/null
            fi
        fi
    done

    unset i
    unset -f pathmunge
fi

commands.command:
set -eu
tmp_file=$(mktemp /tmp/secure-umask.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$tmp_file"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf '%s\n' '# Set the system-wide default umask for new shell sessions.' 'umask 027' > "$tmp_file"
sudo -n install -o root -g root -m 0644 "$tmp_file" /etc/profile.d/zz-secure-umask.sh
if command -v restorecon >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo -n restorecon /etc/profile.d/zz-secure-umask.sh; fi
printf 'installed='; stat -c '%n %U:%G %a' /etc/profile.d/zz-secure-umask.sh
printf '%s\n' 'content:'
sed -n '1,20p' /etc/profile.d/zz-secure-umask.sh
commands.stdout:
installed=/etc/profile.d/zz-secure-umask.sh root:root 644
content:
# Set the system-wide default umask for new shell sessions.
umask 027

commands.command:
set -eu
sudo -n test -f /etc/profile.d/zz-secure-umask.sh
sudo -n test "$(stat -c '%U:%G:%a' /etc/profile.d/zz-secure-umask.sh)" = 'root:root:644'
/bin/bash -n /etc/profile.d/zz-secure-umask.sh
for account in antrieb root; do
  home_dir=$(getent passwd "$account" | cut -d: -f6)
  sudo -n -u "$account" env -i HOME="$home_dir" USER="$account" LOGNAME="$account" SHELL=/bin/bash TERM=dumb PATH=/usr/bin:/bin /bin/bash --login -i -c '
    set -e
    mask=$(umask)
    test "$mask" = "0027"
    test_dir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/umask-check.XXXXXX)
    test_file=$test_dir/file
    test_subdir=$test_dir/directory
    touch "$test_file"
    mkdir "$test_subdir"
    file_mode=$(stat -c %a "$test_file")
    dir_mode=$(stat -c %a "$test_subdir")
    printf "user=%s umask=%s file_mode=%s dir_mode=%s\n" "$(id -un)" "$mask" "$file_mode" "$dir_mode"
    test "$file_mode" = 640
    test "$dir_mode" = 750
    rm -f "$test_file"
    rmdir "$test_subdir" "$test_dir"
  ' 2>/dev/null
done
printf 'config_sha256='; sha256sum /etc/profile.d/zz-secure-umask.sh | awk '{print $1}'

user=root umask=0027 file_mode=640 dir_mode=750
config_sha256=8286843147d5aa040d829fadb101e4b02dbf21a4bf10cde9651ba7ffd2030bee
